The studio

A softer landing.
A stronger you.

Space to notice how you move.
Encouragement to see what’s possible.

Come as you are.
Really.

Form is a studio concept for people who want to feel more at home in their bodies. A place where progress doesn’t need to be loud, and a first class doesn’t need to feel intimidating.

The practice is thoughtful. The atmosphere is warm. The goal is to leave feeling a little more connected than when you arrived.

Find your starting point

Your first visit,
with a little less unknown.

I have never tried Pilates. Where would I start?

Foundations is the introductory class in this example. It is designed around a steady pace and time to become familiar with the movements.

What would I bring to a class?

Comfortable clothes you can move in and a water bottle are a useful start. A real studio would confirm any equipment or grip-sock requirements before your visit.

Can I book a real class here?

No. Form Studio is a fictional concept created by SkipManual. You can explore the class request form to see how the experience works.
